name: Process accounts payable invoices with Gmail, Google Drive, Gemini and QuickBooks

parameters.content:
## Intelligent Accounts Payable Invoice Processing

### How it works

This workflow ingests supplier invoices from Gmail attachments or a Google Drive folder, normalizes the incoming file metadata, and routes each invoice by file type. PDFs are processed through text extraction when possible, while image files or image-only PDFs are sent to Gemini for vision-based extraction; extracted fields are normalized and scored for confidence. High-confidence invoices are logged and posted to QuickBooks, while low-confidence invoices are logged separately and sent to Finance in Slack for review.

### Setup steps

- Connect Gmail and Google Drive credentials, then configure the email trigger and Drive folder trigger to watch the intended invoice sources.
- Configure Google Gemini credentials and prompts/model settings for PDF-text and image invoice field extraction.
- Set up Google Sheets credentials and select the spreadsheets/tabs used for approved invoice logs and low-confidence review logs.
- Configure Slack credentials and choose the Finance review channel for low-confidence invoice notifications.
- Add QuickBooks/Intuit API authentication details, company ID, and sandbox or production base URL for the vendor bill creation HTTP request.
- Run or adapt the isolated QuickBooks setup node if you need to create the demo expense account before posting bills.

### Customization

Adjust the confidence threshold, Gemini extraction prompts, regex hints, supported file-type routing rules, spreadsheet columns, Slack message text, and QuickBooks vendor bill payload to match your AP policies and accounting system setup.

## QuickBooks demo setup

Isolated setup step that creates a demo expense account in QuickBooks before the main invoice-processing flow is used.

## Invoice source intake

Receives invoices from Google Drive or Gmail, normalizes metadata and attachment details, and downloads Drive-hosted invoice files for downstream processing.

## Route file type

Central routing switch that directs downloaded or attached invoice files into the PDF text path or the image/vision extraction path.

## Detect PDF text

Attempts to extract embedded text from PDF invoices and decides whether there is usable text or whether the file should fall back to image-based extraction.

## Extract PDF fields

Prepares extracted PDF text with regex hints, sends it to Gemini for structured invoice field extraction, and normalizes the PDF-derived invoice data.

## Extract image fields

Uses Gemini vision extraction for image invoices and image-only PDFs, then converts the model output into a normalized invoice data structure.

## Check AI confidence

Merges normalized extraction results from the PDF and image paths and branches processing based on whether the AI confidence score is above 90%.

## Post approved invoices

Handles high-confidence invoices by creating a vendor bill in QuickBooks and logging the approved invoice details to Google Sheets.

## Escalate review invoices

Handles low-confidence invoices by recording them in a review sheet and notifying the Finance review channel in Slack.

values.content:
=You are an expert invoice analysis engine for an IT services company.
Extract invoice fields from the text below and return ONE JSON object only (no markdown).

Use regex hints when helpful but prefer the invoice text as source of truth.

Required JSON shape:
{
  "invoice_number": string|null,
  "invoice_date": string|null,
  "due_date": string|null,
  "po_number": string|null,
  "vendor_name": string|null,
  "vendor_address": string|null,
  "vendor_gstin": string|null,
  "customer_name": string|null,
  "customer_gstin": string|null,
  "subtotal": number|null,
  "igst": number|null,
  "grand_total": number|null,
  "currency": "INR",
  "bank_name": string|null,
  "account_number": string|null,
  "ifsc_code": string|null,
  "line_items": [{"item_name": string, "qty": number|null, "rate": number|null, "amount": number|null}]
}

Regex hints:
{{ JSON.stringify($json.regex || {}, null, 2) }}

Invoice text:
{{ $json.text }}

parameters.text:
You are an expert invoice analysis engine for an IT services company.
You receive invoices as images or PDFs (sometimes scanned, sometimes native).
Your job is to:

Read all visible content on the invoice.

Identify and extract key fields and line items.

Return a single JSON object that exactly matches the specified schema.

Set a confidence score between 0 and 1 for each field based on how certain you are.

Never hallucinate values that are not clearly present; use null when a field is missing.
